tripHeadingBody.one: Add anything in the next minute
tripHeadingBody.other: Add anything in the next {minutes} min

waHelp: Send items to add them, e.g. "milk, 2 bread". Send "list" to see the list and "got milk" to tick something off.
waNotLinked: This number isn't linked yet. In the app open Settings > WhatsApp > Link, then send the code here.
waLinked: Linked to {household}. Send items to add them to the list.
waLinkUnknown: That code doesn't work any more. Get a new one in the app.
waVoiceFailed: I couldn't understand the voice note. Please type it.
waTooMany: Too many messages. Please try again later.
